title: Virtual DOM vs Real DOM

# Chapter 1: Virtual DOM vs Real DOM

The Document Object Model (DOM) is an interface representing an HTML document. Directly manipulating the real DOM is performance-heavy due to layout recalculations and repaint operations.

React addresses this with the **Virtual DOM**, an in-memory tree representation of real DOM nodes.

### The Reconciliation Process
Whenever state changes occur, React evaluates differences via reconciliation. Instead of a naive $O(n^3)$ tree comparison, React uses an $O(n)$ heuristic algorithm assuming:
1. Two elements of different types produce different subtrees.
2. Keys remain stable across renders.

Select any keyword to interrogate the Socratic AI on its computational tradeoffs.
